tonight.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
tonight.why: Tonight, prepare for an earth-shattering event as beloved heroes from three universes collide in "Avengers: Doomsday." This isn't just a superhero flick; it's an existential threat demanding your full attention.

releases.title: Avengers: Doomsday
releases.take: When three universes collide, expect more than just fireworks; expect an existential crisis wrapped in a CGI spectacle.

releases.title: The Odyssey
releases.take: Forget your Netflix queue; this epic journey reminds us that true adventure involves gods, monsters, and a hero who really, *really* wants to go home.

releases.title: Hexed
releases.take: Suburbia's got nothing on a vast witch realm, especially when an impulsive teen accidentally unlocks powers and a whole new world of trouble.

critic.title: You Can See Everything
critic.blurb: For the discerning viewer, "The Odyssey" offers a timeless narrative rich with mythological intrigue and human perseverance. It's a grand, sweeping epic that proves some stories are simply meant to endure.
